description: Governor's Secretariat - Sabaragamuwa Province - Second Supplementary Financial Statement 2021 - Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with government structural and administrative changes related to provincial council financial management. It grants permission for expenditure amendments and disbursements from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund, specifying budget allocations across various provincial departments and programs. The content focuses on administrative functions, financial restructuring, and allocation of funds to different government departments without naming any specific individuals or detailing their personal responsibilities. This fits the definition of Organisational Gazette (Type 1) as it concerns government structural/administrative changes without personnel appointments.
